assessed_not_adopted.proposed_by_owner: 2026-09-11, 'open source, checked, clone into project, credit in README'

findings.licence: NONE. GitHub API license=null; /LICENSE returns 404; README carries no licence or reuse statement; coffee.py has no header. Public visibility is not a licence; attribution in our README does not create one.
findings.data: Pickles/df.pickle and df_full.pickle (~5 MB each) hold ~6,000 scraped CoffeeReview reviews per the README — a subset of the 8,387 already ingested from coffee_reviews_parsed.csv. Not inspected: unpickling untrusted files executes arbitrary code.
findings.methods: TF-IDF + NMF topic vectors, lasso/linear/random-forest score predictors (num_to_score_RF.pickle, 12 MB), VADER sentiment, Markov review generation, Streamlit app. These are the fitted and generative paths this project set aside for the proposition lattice.
findings.code: coffee.py is a notebook export (get_ipython(), hard-coded Windows path); scraping_functions.py targets coffeereview.com, which the owner has ruled out for active crawling.

assessed_not_adopted.decision: NOT CLONED. Nothing to adopt: no data beyond what is held, methods the project rejected, code not reusable, and no licence under which to vendor any of it.
assessed_not_adopted.if_owner_still_wants_it: Ask the author for a licence, or cite the README's approach as prior work in the methods notes. Neither requires cloning.
assessed_not_adopted.owner_response_2026_09_11: 不能直接查看那我们就当作辅助吧，用他的 Streamlit app 作为辅助，不直接用数据

final_disposition.meaning: The hosted app may be consulted by a person as an external comparison (e.g. how its NMF topics group descriptors). No data, pickles, or code enter this project; nothing here depends on the app being up.
final_disposition.note: README attribution is not needed because nothing is incorporated.

decisions.subject: R11 supervision architecture (D15)
decisions.sealed_artifact_rule: r11/owner_decision.json is a SEALED R11 artefact and is left exactly as R11 wrote it (status PENDING_OWNER_DECISION, selected_option null, training_authorized false); test_r11_corpus_expansion pins those values.
